clean_body: This woman may not technically speak for the Democrat Party, but she has captured the essence of what her fellow members of Congress believe. | Fellow Conservative, “Asshole. Buffoon. Mofo. Wannabe Hitler. Gangster. Vile villain.” Those are just a few words Rep. Jasmine Crockett used to describe President Trump. But let's be honest: those insults aren't just about him. They're about you. About me. About anyone who leans conservative, wears a uniform, or believes in this country's founding values. They think we're backward. They believe we are in the way. And worst of all, they think we'll take it. As a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran, I've faced far worse than name-calling. I've deployed to over 70 countries. I've led warriors into battle. I've endured life-threatening missions. And the most important lesson I've learned? Quiet professionalism always wins the day. That's why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — not to yell or mock, but tofight with discipline, humility, and relentless purpose. I didn't plan on entering politics. But the more I came home from deployment, the more I saw a Minnesota I didn't recognize. Tim Walz's lieutenant governor — the person I'm running against — isn't just radically out of step with our values; she embodies the same hard-left extremism that's trying to rewrite our entire society. While Walz called for calm in 2020, she was preparing a lawsuit against the Minneapolis Police. As crime soared and businesses burned, she blamed the people trying to hold the line. These are the people in charge now — and they're not moderating. You can close this email and forget my name. Or you can help send the second Navy SEAL to the U.S. Senate — someone trained for chaos, unafraid of the fight, and grounded in service, not ego. I grew up playing hockey. I joined the Marine Corps on my 18th birthday in October 2001, less than two months after 9/11. I served because I love this country, wanted to make my mom proud, and knew I had something to give. Twenty-four years later, I still feel that calling. It's just a different kind of battlefield. This won't be easy. Minnesota hasn't gone red in a presidential election since 1976. And I know I'm the underdog — just a regular guy from Minnesota who's been asked to do extraordinary things one more time. With your help, I know we can flip this Senate seat for the Republican Party - but that will require you getting involved TODAY. And you have a choice. I've earned advanced degrees from Harvard and Johns Hopkins. I've trained in nuclear deterrence. I've worked across cultures, built teams under pressure, and led calmly when it mattered most. But none of that compares to the challenge ahead of me now — earning your trust and building a movement powerful enough to flip this seat. I'm not asking for a blank check. I'm asking for a chance. Because we still live in a country worth defending. Respect and results still matter. And I believe people like you are ready to fight — not with insults, but with action. Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1jb9hlor0bqo03dp6uvoo3dpekfwgx00htscdwan8yrb7d5xjhe1ynmzua56zhvipxs4pr0i9dz4d04pd1vcnqxgkgj9t0hwteiqzkd6opuorhx23mnq3cilqo377kgvgq228awfby&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t1rjbl&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t1rjbl&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t1rjbl&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t1rjbl&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1jb9hlor0bqo03dp6uvoo3dpekfwgx00htscdwan8yrb7d5xjhe1ynmzua56zhvipxs4pr0i9dz4d04pd1vcnqxgkgj9t0hwteiqzkd6opuorhx23mnq3cilqo377kgvgq228awfby&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t1rjbl&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t1rjbl&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Dear Patriot,

I'm James O'Keefe, and right now, my heart aches as I write this.

I built Project Veritas with my bare hands, **risking my freedom and dedicating my life to shining light on evil.**

It was more than a job – **it was my calling**.

Then, they fired me, the founder, and hit me with a lawsuit to bury me and [**I need your help to keep going.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

This betrayal has tried my soul like nothing else, pitting pure good against profound evil in a war for truth.

**But justice is stirring.**

On July 15, a federal judge ordered their former Chief of Staff to sit for a face-to-face videotaped deposition. **He fought it on July 26 over embarrassment fears, but lost on August 13**. This step could expose the darkness within their ranks.

To push forward, [**we must fund this deposition**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) – the fees, the prep, the battle.

**Your gift today fuels the good in this epic struggle.[**Please donate and help me win**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.).**

With gratitude and resolve,
James O’Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

Peter,

You may not know me yet, but my name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a lifelong Minnesotan, former Navy SEAL, and Marine Corps veteran running for U.S. Senate in 2026. I’m stepping into this fight because Minnesota—and our country—needs a new voice to stand up for our values, and I’m asking for your help to make it happen.

I grew up in Bloomington, Minnesota, playing hockey and learning teamwork from my working-class parents. _**On my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after 9/11, I enlisted in the Marine Corps to serve our nation.**_

**Over 21 years, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries as a Marine and Navy SEAL, putting my life on the line to defend our freedoms.** I earned my undergraduate degree from the University of Minnesota, a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But at my core, I’m a regular guy who wants to make my mom proud and fight for the Minnesota I love.

Right now, Minnesota and America face a critical moment. The radical policies of Tim Walz and his lieutenant governor—who’s running to replace retiring Senator Tina Smith—threaten our way of life. From the unrest in Minneapolis in 2020 to attacks on our police, their agenda doesn’t reflect the Minnesota I know. _**This open Senate seat in 2026 is our chance to take back our state and stop the left’s push toward extremism. Just like in Georgia, where one seat flipped the Senate majority in 2021, Minnesota’s vote could decide the future of the U.S. Senate.

**_ **But here’s the challenge: I’m a new face, and the Democrats are already raising millions to keep this seat.** I’ve noticed you haven’t been active lately, Peter, and I get it—the news can feel overwhelming, and it’s easy to think the fight’s already won. But it’s not. Right now, donations are slowing, and the other side is **quietly building its war chest**. I’m thinking of patriots like you who’ve supported conservatives before. Your past support has helped Republicans win tough battles, and we need you now to introduce me to Minnesota voters.

**[I’m asking for just $5 today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c8d5bfef343543cbb3096d1785701f61&_e=GRbOncNY4n0s3UC2L5pzjsKtsI0dcBfkI1atsfthNqrTRBIkmP6AoC5qPWFNzhnbVFMkSgGInN2H8SahzlX-hs1qXYOu7o1WeKhBA8fpKiwRjHUsfEe3KSjzPhEbIIMWZO6gfgNaMzi7H-K8PPCVEBt3rlwmikrD4q2EgvZwbyTw75aMZ5A0tlB7Wmg_pik2Gz5tkt-Smj7wVqc_PRBbcnCmQdK5_KgtgjCbjKlJhen0_WRKtGAsWauk4QD5_CgZva8b1ZvzUbrwP9SiTSyUXPgsq6OFRJYG2vhbT8NViSNpFGSFpDeXR3pNRWvtVlpw1uROhv6g19AYd--OZYtXEps6dD6LmV0lepJX0VmghMi2J6r3E1fl3aAhVYBGugXxdhtW-bnFq6RzrNsQj5RDvwQxKG3ccfp_wPYmBpxAIkU__V-hsh1NSDZZUkmxtuhamtuxjm-hpM1GjNXtZ5CkuI3gHrHZHtjmPrnUVol9-0voh0tNKzfRLj8GmUKhtuJK0hl5eV2kQypzLqAvhCMA2qo2Mes5rW_e7PJ43kCLwxukVktiOKdTHq_a7I1bGU_kGMf_2fEwD-ErcQIARjpBLPl9HF4hfxVKO5BJkM17_f8LUv-72BVKh3PNUHu33IJTl-poJcJ9MoU5xj6eXrGYWWFATRI8kB6nDFVzcbCpN2oX7vPh05JmGWJ9ZDdEZQvwXFp_jHGI53bLoxT3u2x-BWm008lWicGTCwfSGvHdzeRZ0-1Vuo4D9o6iPFjisnlxyC_L5Zj9rJX6fhjBQjaYUg%3D%3D)** It’s not about the amount—it’s a signal that you’re with me, that you believe Minnesota and America deserve a conservative fighter who’s served our nation and will serve you in Washington.

Right now, donations are slowing, and the other side is quietly building its war chest. I’m thinking of patriots like you who’ve supported conservatives before. Your past support has helped Republicans win tough battles, and we need you now to introduce me to Minnesota voters. It’s not about the amount—it’s a signal that you’re with me, that you believe Minnesota and America deserve a conservative fighter who’s served our nation and will serve you in Washington. As a Navy SEAL, I’ve thrived in the most challenging missions and am ready for this campaign. But I can’t do it without you. We need thousands of grassroots supporters, not Hollywood elites or mega-donors like the Democrats rely on. Minnesota hasn’t voted Republican for president since 1976, but this race is winnable. I’m running to secure our borders, support law enforcement, revive our economy, and protect our freedoms. Please, chip in $5 today to help me introduce myself to Minnesotans and fight for our shared values. # THE MENDOZA BRIEF

# August Endorsement Roundup
---
| | August was a HUGE month for endorsements!
This month, Jo was proud to receive endorsements from **Senator Mark Kelly, former Arizona Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, GIFFORDS PAC, Congresswoman Emily Randall, and Elect Democratic Women.**
The endorsements come as Jo’s campaign has seen widespread support from local and national organizations, community leaders, and grassroots donors. Raising **over $1.3 million** since launching in February, Jo has emerged as the clear frontrunner to take on vulnerable Juan Ciscomani next year.
To see the full list of endorsements, click or tap below!
---
| [Check out the full list of endorsements here!](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=f23d59e578&e=fea3203902)

[|
---](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=c8dc9fd010&e=fea3203902)
|
---
| |
# Holding Juan Ciscomani Accountable
---
| | Last week, Jo held a press conference at the Oro Valley Community Center with local families and community members to highlight the devastating impact of Congressman Ciscomani’s vote for the “Big Billionaire Bill”.
Jo underscored how Ciscomani’s vote will raise costs, strip health care access, and threaten jobs across Southern Arizona.
---
[|
---](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=30b2dbb695&e=fea3203902)
| | _“Energy prices are through the roof, housing is out of reach, and food and gas prices remain high. [Juan Ciscomani] cast the deciding vote for [a bill] that showers tax breaks on the wealthy and rips the floor out from underneath working families here at home.”_
Jo shared her own story growing up in a farmworker family in Pinal County, where programs like SNAP and Medicaid ensured she could grow up healthy and serve her country for over 20 years. She emphasized that these programs, which helped her and countless families pay their bills, are now **under attack**.
Jo was joined by**Kat Stratford** , a single mother of two, who described how Ciscomani’s vote will force families like hers to pay hundreds more in energy bills while jeopardizing access to affordable health care.
_“Between the cost of rent, groceries, and utilities, it feels like the cost of living is rising every day. That’s why I am furious that Congressman Juan Ciscomani voted for that Big Billionaire Bill.,” said**Stratford**. “He would rather give billionaires tax breaks than focus on lowering costs for Southern Arizonans. We need a fighter like Jo to represent us in Southern Arizona. I know she will focus on lowering costs for families like mine and fight like hell to protect our health care.”_
Jo was also joined by **Jenalyn Lazana** , who works with seniors relying on Social Security, warned about Ciscomani’s broken promises to protect retirement security.
_“Every single day at my job, I work with seniors on Social Security that are making decisions between groceries and paying their Medicare premiums,”**Lazana** said. “I am sick of Congressman Ciscomani saying one thing in Arizona and then voting another way in Washington, DC. That’s why I am proud to support Jo Mendoza for Congress who will look out for our seniors and protect Social Security and Medicare.”_
---
[|
---](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=9d04d05517&e=fea3203902)
|
---
| |
# Moving Into 2026 Strong and Unified
---
| | This month, Mo Goldman, who was another candidate seeking the Democratic nomination for Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District, announced that he is withdrawing from the race.
We want to thank Mo for his service to his community and we appreciate his support as Jo is ready to carry this fight, strong and unified, into 2026!
---
|
---
| |
# Jo is on the Go!
---
| | The 2026 general election is 431 days away - and Jo is already out in the district, listening and meeting with constituents, and laying the groundwork to fight for southern Arizonans in DC. Stay tuned for when Jo will be in a community near you!

clean_body: We're so excited to share the latest news with you! | | | | | | | | | | | | THE MENDOZA BRIEF The Latest News from Team Mendoza August 29, 2025 | | The Mendoza Brief is a way for our campaign to share the latest news, opportunities, and updates from the campaign trail. 🏜️ | | | | August Endorsement Roundup | | August was a HUGE month for endorsements! This month, Jo was proud to receive endorsements from Senator Mark Kelly, former Arizona Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, GIFFORDS PAC, Congresswoman Emily Randall, and Elect Democratic Women. The endorsements come as Jo’s campaign has seen widespread support from local and national organizations, community leaders, and grassroots donors. Raising over $1.3 million since launching in February, Jo has emerged as the clear frontrunner to take on vulnerable Juan Ciscomani next year. To see the full list of endorsements, click or tap below! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Holding Juan Ciscomani Accountable | | Last week, Jo held a press conference at the Oro Valley Community Center with local families and community members to highlight the devastating impact of Congressman Ciscomani’s vote for the “Big Billionaire Bill”. Jo underscored how Ciscomani’s vote will raise costs, strip health care access, and threaten jobs across Southern Arizona. | | “Energy prices are through the roof, housing is out of reach, and food and gas prices remain high. [Juan Ciscomani] cast the deciding vote for [a bill] that showers tax breaks on the wealthy and rips the floor out from underneath working families here at home.” Jo shared her own story growing up in a farmworker family in Pinal County, where programs like SNAP and Medicaid ensured she could grow up healthy and serve her country for over 20 years. She emphasized that these programs, which helped her and countless families pay their bills, are now under attack. Jo was joined byKat Stratford , a single mother of two, who described how Ciscomani’s vote will force families like hers to pay hundreds more in energy bills while jeopardizing access to affordable health care. “Between the cost of rent, groceries, and utilities, it feels like the cost of living is rising every day. That’s why I am furious that Congressman Juan Ciscomani voted for that Big Billionaire Bill.,” saidStratford. “He would rather give billionaires tax breaks than focus on lowering costs for Southern Arizonans. We need a fighter like Jo to represent us in Southern Arizona. I know she will focus on lowering costs for families like mine and fight like hell to protect our health care.” Jo was also joined by Jenalyn Lazana , who works with seniors relying on Social Security, warned about Ciscomani’s broken promises to protect retirement security. “Every single day at my job, I work with seniors on Social Security that are making decisions between groceries and paying their Medicare premiums,”Lazana said. “I am sick of Congressman Ciscomani saying one thing in Arizona and then voting another way in Washington, DC. That’s why I am proud to support Jo Mendoza for Congress who will look out for our seniors and protect Social Security and Medicare.” | | | Moving Into 2026 Strong and Unified | | This month, Mo Goldman, who was another candidate seeking the Democratic nomination for Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District, announced that he is withdrawing from the race. subject: Re: Bobby Kennedy Jr.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
#

_See this:_
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-august25.AuYWG3&refcode=em250829-1-f&t=1&akid=697%2E5691347%2E6WFTfU)
This is yet more evidence that putting a quack like Bobby Kennedy in charge of public health was a grave error. The Trump Administration has been engaged for months in a campaign to destroy the CDC, America’s preeminent disease-fighting agency. The Administration’s extremism and incompetence are putting lives at risk.
During the Senate floor debate on RFK earlier this year, I argued:
_"If the Senate weren’t gripped in this soon-to-be infamous period of total capitulation, I don’t think this nominee would have made it as far as a hearing."_
Hours later, Senate Republicans totally capitulated and confirmed to lead American public health a man famous only for his name and his embrace of conspiracist pseudoscience.
_Total capitulation._
Historians will fill books about this moment in history.
They’ll write about the destruction of America’s public health institutions — the firing of scientists, the silencing of experts, the gutting of the CDC.
They’ll write about their dereliction of duty during an unprecedented attack on the role of Congress as a co-equal branch of government.
As Trump elevated utterly unqualified zealots and loyalists to the nation's most powerful offices, Republican Senators suspend their judgement, march onto the Senate floor, and vote AYE.
Some knew better. You saw it in their faces. They looked ashamed. They still voted AYE.
That brings me to the 2026 election.
_2026 is our only hope to recover Congressional power and reverse this descent toward one-man rule._
And here in Georgia I am the only Democratic U.S. Senator nationwide up for reelection in a state Trump won.
I am therefore MAGA’s #1 target for defeat.
_There is no path back without defending this seat — the seat that secured the Democratic majority four years ago._
So I'm asking for your help. Not for me, for all of us.
[**Please consider contributing to my campaign straight away.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-august25.AuYWG3&refcode=em250829-1-f&t=2&akid=697%2E5691347%2E6WFTfU)
With gratitude,
Senator Jon Ossoff

Hi Derek, John here.
Before you log off for the weekend, I need your help. Our end-of-month goal is coming up fast, and I can’t afford to fall short.
I’ll be straight with you. The road ahead’s rough. But the mission’s simple: **kick extremist Republicans out so Democrats can steer this ship straight.** 🥾
These extremist Republicans don’t care who they hurt. They only care about keeping their wealthy friends happy.
And those friends? _They bankroll the whole racket._ Big money buys the ads. Big money spreads the lies. If they said it plain – that they’re taking money from your kid's health care to make their rich friends richer – they’d never win a single race.
**I don’t play those games. I tell the truth. I fight for working families. Doesn’t make me popular with Wall Street. Fine by me.**
But here’s the deal: In a couple days, the Senate’s back. And so are extremist Republicans – spreading lies to cover their tracks while they gut the programs millions count on. 😡
That's why I need you. If we’re gonna keep up the fight to stop Trump and his cronies from dismantling Social Security, if we're going to fight to reverse the Medicaid cuts from Trump's Big, Ugly Betrayal – _then we need to get the truth out._
**And to do that, we need everyone on this team to chip in right now to hit our $30,000 end-of-month goal.**

I won’t let wannabe dictators silence your voice. Not now, not ever.
In Michigan we have very clear rules around who draws our districts. It’s the citizens of our state — because we voted to amend our constitution to put power in the hands of the people, not politicians.
All of this back and forth about redistricting and voting by mail shows that we have a president willing to attack the law and our own democracy.
_Why is he so desperate to change the rules of the game?_

He doesn’t want to face voters in fair districts with fair voting rules, so he’s instead trying to rig the election and make it harder for you all — the American voter — to hold him accountable in 2026 and beyond.**
I won’t stand for it. And neither should you. We’re going to protect democracy and protect the voice and power of every Michigander and every American.

| | I was raised in a union household. As the son of a union power line worker and a mom who managed the books while raising eight kids, I learned early in life the value of a dollar and the importance of hard work — and how unions and good labor policy helped families like mine thrive. **Labor literally put a shirt on my back and food on my family's table growing up. | | All good things must come to an end.
This district work period back home in Tennessee has been one for the books, but it’s time to wrap it up and head back to the swamp—or as I like to call it, the sewer.
We packed in everything from fundraising dinners to visits with small businesses, and most importantly, a lot of good old-fashioned heart-to-heart chats with the folks who voted me into office.
This month lit a fire in me and reminded me why I wanted to do this job in the first place: to serve the people of East Tennessee. I heard directly from you about what matters most, and I’ll be carrying those conversations with me when I walk back into the Capitol next week.
We talked about the America First agenda and how much you appreciate the progress President Trump has made securing the border and cleaning up crime in blue cities like D.C.
I heard your concerns about our spiraling national debt, and we agreed that cooling inflation is still a top priority for hard-working families.
Many of you shared encouraging words about my efforts to ban stock trading for members of Congress—and you urged me to keep pushing for answers on the Epstein filth and other forms of corruption.
I know I’ve said it before, but I really mean it: I take everything you say into consideration. You all keep me in the know and remind me who I work for and what we’re working toward.
Before I get on the plane, I’m hoping to fit in a few more sit-down talks and a couple stops at Vol Market #3—but I’m ready to tackle the rest of the year in a big way.
The fights ahead won’t be easy. If we want to pave the way for success in 2026 (and keep Republicans in charge so we can get things done), we’ve got to stay focused and keep pushing.
Thank you for your trust, and I promise to keep doing everything I can to make you proud.

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | Moments That Matter 🧡 | | | | All good things must come to an end. This district work period back home in Tennessee has been one for the books, but it’s time to wrap it up and head back to the swamp—or as I like to call it, the sewer. We packed in everything from fundraising dinners to visits with small businesses, and most importantly, a lot of good old-fashioned heart-to-heart chats with the folks who voted me into office. This month lit a fire in me and reminded me why I wanted to do this job in the first place: to serve the people of East Tennessee. I heard directly from you about what matters most, and I’ll be carrying those conversations with me when I walk back into the Capitol next week. We talked about the America First agenda and how much you appreciate the progress President Trump has made securing the border and cleaning up crime in blue cities like D.C. I heard your concerns about our spiraling national debt, and we agreed that cooling inflation is still a top priority for hard-working families. Many of you shared encouraging words about my efforts to ban stock trading for members of Congress—and you urged me to keep pushing for answers on the Epstein filth and other forms of corruption. I know I’ve said it before, but I really mean it: I take everything you say into consideration. You all keep me in the know and remind me who I work for and what we’re working toward. Before I get on the plane, I’m hoping to fit in a few more sit-down talks and a couple stops at Vol Market #3—but I’m ready to tackle the rest of the year in a big way. The fights ahead won’t be easy. If we want to pave the way for success in 2026 (and keep Republicans in charge so we can get things done), we’ve got to stay focused and keep pushing. Thank you for your trust, and I promise to keep doing everything I can to make you proud. | | Are You Ready For Some Football? 🏈 | | | | All my rowdy friends know what time it is—but we don’t care much about Monday night. | Peter — North Carolina is a swing state, and we can be sure that Republicans will go all out to defeat us. But I know how to win North Carolina. Whether it was Attorney General or Governor, I’ve done it over and over in the most competitive years. It takes the dedication to connect with folks in every community, the commitment to fight for the rights that people hold dear, and the courage to stand up in the face of threats to the progress we’ve made. I served as Governor for eight years. I know that North Carolinians don’t want to go backward. And based on the enthusiasm we’re seeing for our campaign from people across our country, that sentiment is true for Americans everywhere. As a U.S. Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, clean air and drinking water, and more. Asking you to chip in your hard-earned money to keep our re-election campaign running strong is my least favorite part about my job. Especially when we’re closing in on key deadlines like Sunday’s end-of-month benchmark.

In the last seven months, we’ve seen an exhausting amount of extreme actions from the Trump White House.

I’m fighting tooth and nail to protect Central and Southern Illinois, and I’m deeply concerned about the millions of working families who stand to lose their health care and food assistance – just so billionaires get a tax break.

Despite the negative coverage and devastating impact on Illinoisans, we’re finding a way to push back successfully. Last month, the Trump Administration finally released federal funding for education **[after I helped put on the pressure](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/114244721/566408523/-1547874?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjAyZmUwZC0wMDg1LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bfjU_3QqY1fDCA_LCQLQ_848gOaueEpxlJQGJQqJmAk=&emci=858f0ead-f884-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=2602fe0d-0085-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=13891387)**.

There is a glimmer of hope: If we keep this seat blue, Democrats have a fighting chance to control the House majority next year and put an end to the MAGA agenda.

So we can’t slow down for a second: I already have two GOP challengers in this race, and the national GOP is attacking me in the hopes of flipping IL-13 back to red.

Peter, Trump’s self-named “Big Beautiful Bill” is going to be a disaster for people across the country. **Oregon alone is projected to lose $15 billion in federal funding — your tax money not coming to Oregon for health care, food benefits, and other essential services.** The Trump Administration and Republicans in Congress have betrayed American children and families, who will become sicker, hungrier, and less prosperous because of this budget bill. But I’m not going to stand by while Oregonians lose their tax dollars and our safety net to fund tax cuts for billionaires. I am going to work with lawmakers and community partners to do all that we can to stand up for Oregonians and get through this needless, callous hardship. I will continue to hold the line and push back as Oregon values are under threat. **[To do that, I need your support. Your gift will go towards communications, research, and mobilizing folks to fight back against Trump’s attacks on working families. | | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/hbTpsptFIGtrDoQ-_D_mnqE5Yusd1kcozGnMnL1OcSj6QHYONU-C7nv5GD4gZo1Xc-gftGGL0bApOJBLEU89WVtCdBgxa-26qaNlnmLzcHh5dOB1T0DDaOewm5mAEKPPAdDNFfDgN-L3XXUS6K3MtRLxV0Yxkmgmh6IuLbZxaD_wpWSdHzLQeEm7GIlyiyVCb4QwAJTbbhWGSD60s6eX7asCIwwGC_S8jl2HQw3tkxoZXe3pBcT6uIzQx8hvP0fdyANtEyWWGy0wGfuwzviPIKiFUtNAegBx7L1nPesO8z820RgdoYoJ7twE9l6pQcbzQT1ZrNA0NDlHpAgR2F4LGXKg6VVe2kFk0VdMhO3A9_Lp1Ca-QvQUWzdF7t4VdzDR1vTnrWmGxP-dbfjrQnz-3jVcZEYxMBbNSEK66P4DckxM9FgbPL5fBK7u_erhpcVpnoGllbrNlBvu0rOeUPeBqYZ4W4FS9JjHpJc3iGT-urer3sPX5Yr0kXK8-oD3BCW191_kHfFKDk42KvFNsPsPCCkoBoMlzozKg42fyD-5wN6UvF_hpu85iflN6ZxKgUotkE6216GMZ0p-H-VNwY3QQIdWQDRGhJXqFBeFiUeMDt3c3ZaxovSS45DOHhcUY6oN-kkBzkppb7pu_kyMulN50Aep_KtY3lZLfrfOqm17sL4YhwPMLX0wo_xRldeclKaYlbGbLDrF4RdpIBaragKyO7viIWP8B64VTA/aAVmjIuPwmg5timeLkmZEEW4dT07tYP_/12) [NO](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/Ay--poWOJWawQCJlN8o0b3o3LQqg6hVqBJyvPGdGtpaOrI7ROOsJJdgGYVFZ39b8_enaXOtWpfn263R0-CyAgN1Cl2bp7MepAp556W0lkMKeebqXcmhAr7lpWuZybQb3LYr5R5oUtmHpRecrPpqXIOULPh39pe568er4IdXQ1cyLuDv6sJ9iBmNpAEPubMc8k4fbcAGLLoLvKknQNix6RsRI4qB4vCdi-kb0lH_OAkp1cr4G_LgFhuEZJewsNhF31_qL-M246D_Ny8eGwy-EvZ3tnVc_BKod9hvpXJh92B1_z6hJNIwW_UA2ieyfdn1eSRdE41PGemvtdG6it71tkBoTd37jsN-3nrKdqFINrDqiTZdkmASq3EO0Y_DKPusU1dJ3KDtyxWbv3HQkB2d2mr1HAzQ9kuh-C0ajnOp5Pk6V_7OFCjbkn8tzhk1i8xniLGXgYIBZ418EeD-hPl4aOcLdwe9Opef1mZCcrlC7amc5nzufOaTd4lPmcJg3mIGcqBjC6Q4jkLskuZtAJ3jxySpcKcwsINp-f288fegyF2QkeGbM1DO-CjjbyRE9d51jE5LoCs4jDwim-Pzk8YnuqwWxAYgTuYvfZcubWPxo8-3xbZpRp2_erJh3OMVvAi2bfjTJ1hAEprWkCctr286ezlL5M6pLCH_vbrU5Ipv9LuuqvzsZF9yuCaTvG7G4V4KClmm5Qd9X7sSFZ7fDyr38rueyixBKw4WW0A/ANuf_-tgkPwhQ4GdD5PeqyffuqMtudAH/12) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you today...

_What is your opinion about the Supreme Court 's role in our constitutional republic? _

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Our MAGA challenger
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
When it comes to campaigning, our motto has always been to focus on our record, and not give any extreme right-wing opponents any free publicity.
But even if we don’t talk about them much, the reality is we have to take our Republican challengers seriously. In 2020, Alexandria was in the second most expensive House race in the country. Her challenger raised and spent more than $10 million against her. And even when our challengers don’t win, the disinformation they sow can discredit our movement if we don’t fight back.
But we have a MAGA challenger for November, and she's fundraising.
[We’re now asking if you will contribute $5 today to support Alexandria and ensure we have the resources to win next year? When thousands of people give what they can, it shows the power of this movement.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250829.LvyeKW&refcode=em20250829-9642-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9642%2E2526796%2E17GxX4)
Here are a few facts about our opponent:
* **She paid George Santos a lot of money to consult on the 2022 election.** She paid George Santos’ consulting firm $110,320 and hers was the only campaign to ever report working with the firm.
* **Her campaign may have been part of a scam run by George Santos.** A donor who gave to Santos had their credit card charged for additional, unauthorized donations — including two maxed-out $2,900 contributions to her campaign. 1
* She participated in the **January 6 Insurrection rally.**
* **She is associated with the white supremacist Proud Boys** and proudly posted a photo of herself with their leaders.

We know that communities in The Bronx, Queens, and across the country support our message and want AOC to stay in Congress – but we need to show it by making sure Alexandria wins again by a considerable margin.
[Can you chip in $5 or whatever you can today? Every dollar helps us reach more voters to ensure that we have the resources to reach voters all across New York’s 14th district so Alexandria wins by a HUGE margin next year.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250829.LvyeKW&refcode=em20250829-9642-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9642%2E2526796%2E17GxX4)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250829.LvyeKW&refcode=em20250829-9642-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=9642%2E2526796%2E17GxX4)**
Together we can keep winning and send Alexandria back to Congress for another term to keep fighting for social, economic, racial, and environmental justice for all.
Thank you for being with us,
Team AOC

Every chip here, every little slice there, every restriction passed on our fundamental right to vote erodes our democracy . At a time when every level of government seems pushed and strained to stretch the limits of legality, we can't afford bills like this passing in North Carolina or anywhere else.
We need your help to stop opponents of voting rights from testing more limits on our rights. RUSH $25 or more right now to defend our elections and stop them before they can bring this up for a vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082925_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NC Newsline: NC House bill would allow elections board workers to be replaced with political hires [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082925_2&amount=25]
Get this, Team: Opponents of voting rights in North Carolina have introduced a sweeping elections bill that, among other steps, would bar election officials from encouraging or promoting voter turnout. This is just the latest and starkest example of a trend among the vote suppressors of opposing even nonpartisan outreach efforts that could boost voting rates.
This bill would also take more than a third of existing nonpartisan staff positions at the state elections office and convert them to jobs for partisan political appointees deeply invested in the results of the elections they would be in charge of. Finally, the measure would add new voting restrictions for military and overseas voters, and ban ranked choice voting.
The bill and proposed ban on promoting turnout “ raises real questions about what democracy means in North Carolina, who really holds the power, who government is answering to ” according to Andrew Garber, a counsel in the nonpartisan Brennan Center’s Voting Rights and Elections Program.
Opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections. It's just another example of what they'll export around the country if they get away with it here.
This troubling bill has the potential to impact us all, no matter what state we live in. Please pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help us stop voter suppression in North Carolina and across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082925_2&amount=25]

Wondering how this impacts you? It's as simple as this: Rep. Allison Dahle, a top defender of voting rights on North Carolina’s House Elections committee, said, “ I think North Carolina has become a testing ground. It’s become a place where they say, ‘let’s see if it works.’ ”
For decades, the voter suppression movement has taken bills that pass in one state and exported them across the country. The leaders at a sprawling, dark money conservative think-tank have taken credit for it, caught on camera bragging about writing the legislation at their headquarters. For example -- the sweeping suppression bill passed in Georgia in March of 2021 was adapted and passed in states like Texas, Florida, and beyond in the months afterward.
It's all just the latest extreme anti-democracy tactic pioneered by North Carolina vote suppressors over the last decade or so. In 2016, a court found that the state’s voter suppression law targeted Black voters with “surgical precision.” They drew multiple gerrymandered maps, and stripped the new governor of several election-related powers before he took office. After the 2024 election, they waged a months-long campaign, ultimately unsuccessful, to overturn a Supreme Court race by having over 65,000 valid votes thrown out after the vote-counting, and two recounts, had been completed. It's not going to end until we stop them.
We have to fight back every time they try to chip away at our fundamental right to vote. Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can today to stop this bill and suppression bills like it nationwide? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082925_2&amount=25]

Peter,

When Christina made the decision to move to Iowa, it was to give her daughter a better future through education. **At the time, Iowa’s schools were among the very best in the country. We ranked in the top five nationally in reading and math scores.**

_But today, the story is very different. We’ve fallen to 20th in the nation, and it shows._

In Iowa, support for education has slipped badly. Teachers are stretched thin, districts are underfunded, and students are paying the price.

This didn’t happen by accident. Year after year, politicians like Mariannette Miller-Meeks have chipped away at public education. They’ve handed over a billion dollars in public money to private schools, offered funding increases that don’t even keep up with inflation, and slashed services rural districts depend on. To make matters worse, they’ve turned educators into political targets instead of giving them the respect they deserve.

**It’s no wonder families are asking themselves if Iowa is still the best place for their kids. Our state quarter says “Foundation in Education,” but right now, that foundation is crumbling.** While Mariannette Miller-Meeks looks the other way, Christina is ready to do something about it.

As a mom and proud graduate of public schools, Christina knows what’s at stake, and she’s committed to rebuilding Iowa’s reputation as a place where every child has the chance to succeed.

clean_body: | = Peter, When Christina made the decision to move to Iowa, it was to give her daughter a better future through education. At the time, Iowa’s schools were among the very best in the country. We ranked in the top five nationally in reading and math scores. But today, the story is very different. We’ve fallen to 20th in the nation, and it shows. In Iowa, support for education has slipped badly. Teachers are stretched thin, districts are underfunded, and students are paying the price. This didn’t happen by accident. Year after year, politicians like Mariannette Miller-Meeks have chipped away at public education. They’ve handed over a billion dollars in public money to private schools, offered funding increases that don’t even keep up with inflation, and slashed services rural districts depend on. To make matters worse, they’ve turned educators into political targets instead of giving them the respect they deserve. It’s no wonder families are asking themselves if Iowa is still the best place for their kids. Our state quarter says “Foundation in Education,” but right now, that foundation is crumbling. While Mariannette Miller-Meeks looks the other way, Christina is ready to do something about it. As a mom and proud graduate of public schools, Christina knows what’s at stake, and she’s committed to rebuilding Iowa’s reputation as a place where every child has the chance to succeed. = If you've Hey folks,
This week's episode of _Welcome To The Party, Pal!_ is one of the most emotional and unflinching conversations we've had. We dig into the horrifying Minnesota shooting, the hollow ritual of "thoughts and prayers," and why Democrats must stop being afraid to fight for real change. There's rage, there's heartbreak, and most importantly--there's clarity. If you care about safety, freedom, and political courage, this one's a must-watch.
* **[00:01:53]** Joe's discomfort with the Democratic response to the Minnesota shooting -- A powerful moment where he calls out both sides for their failures--and how we can do better without losing our humanity.
* **[00:06:02]** Beyond guns: unpacking the root causes of mass shootings -- I lay out the intersection of disaffection, mental health, and weak policy responses, and why neither party is talking about real solutions.
* **[00:18:02]** What most gun owners actually believe -- Joe opens up about why he left the NRA and how Democrats can find common ground with millions of responsible gun owners.
* **[00:20:12]** Why Trump's approach to crime is performative and dangerous -- We expose the emptiness of militarized policing and offer real solutions rooted in community and investment.
* **[00:31:15]** Democrats: Take the offensive or lose the country -- From gun control to immigration to economic messaging, we break down how to win by telling the truth and showing up in the fight.

This is the kind of clarity we need right now.

Friend, Yesterday we recognized August 28, a national day to give to Black-led non-profit organizations. **The day also marks important moments in Black Americans’ long fight for freedom and equity.** For example, on August 28 1963, over 250,000 people joined the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, where Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. gave his “I Have a Dream” speech. I joined the Black-led group **Detroit Justice Center** at last year’s Detroit MLK Day Rally and March, where we spoke about his anti-war and pro-worker legacy. **I’m proud to work alongside this non-profit law firm in the push for racial justice, economic equity, and a transformed criminal legal system.** **Detroit Justice Center’s movement lawyers represent protesters, such as anti-war students for Palestine and people impacted by police brutality—successfully getting charges dismissed.** The group has also won transformative victories to protect our right to protest, clear criminal records, and end profit-seeking predatory policing. Together, we’ve rallied and educated local residents on alternatives to incarceration. As a thought partner, Detroit Justice Center uplifts the needs of currently and formerly incarcerated people, helping shape my policies for housing justice and for shifting public funds to community needs rather than state violence. _Photo from a training led by Detroit Justice Center’s Restorative Justice Network_
A national leader in the fight to transform the criminal legal system, Detroit Justice Center fights against the cash bail system and the debt-to-jail pipeline that keeps people locked in cycles of poverty.
While pushing to end racist policing, the group also provides urgent legal services to keep clients out of jail and remove barriers to housing and employment.
Detroit Justice Center helps pay off people’s court debt, expunge records, reunite families involved in the criminal legal system, and keep people in their homes by assisting in eviction cases and helping people keep their water on.
Detroit Justice Center also empowers people to navigate and transform unjust systems and to create solidarity economies with democratically governed cooperatives. They provide legal support to returning citizens seeking to start businesses, as well as to community land trusts seeking to build affordable housing, and worker cooperatives led by Black women and women of color.
Detroit Justice Center is building infrastructure for truly democratic systems and for restorative justice (an alternative way of addressing harm). They’re also pushing to divest from policing and incarceration and instead invest in our communities’ health and well-being. I’m proud to fight for this in Congress: I won’t stop demanding to move money from state violence to community needs such as housing and healthcare.
Detroit Justice Center’s staff and board members include formerly incarcerated people who understand the struggle. A post on their website references the tradition of Black August, which honors political prisoners and those who gave their lives to the movement for Black liberation:
> _“Black August draws our attention to both a long legacy of Black folks’ resistance to oppression and the role of the prison in suppressing that resistance. Our work at the Detroit Justice Center proudly draws from that long legacy of rebellion and boldly calls for an end to all forms of policing and incarceration.”_ 1

Together, we’ve rallied and educated local residents on alternatives to incarceration—and each year Detroit Justice Center educates the next generation of freedom fighters at our Youth Civic Engagement Fellowship.
**Detroit Justice Center has won fights to secure our right to protest and to expand criminal record expungement opportunities**. They’re providing urgent legal services to keep clients out of jail—through helping pay off people’s court debt, reinstating licenses, and removing obstacles such as warrants for unpaid fees.
They’re also **reuniting families** involved in the criminal legal system, and**keeping people in their homes** by assisting in eviction cases and helping people keep their water on.
Detroit Justice Center’s initiatives include **shifting funds out of policing and increasing investment in non-carceral solutions** , training residents on how to mediate harm without relying on police (also known as restorative justice), and helping people imagine a world without prisons or police.
They envision a “future where every life is valued equally,” including “affordable and safe housing for all.”2 As part of that vision, Detroit Justice Center pushes for economic self-determination, providing legal support to:
* **Community land trusts** , which allow residents to own land and decide what development looks like in their neighborhoods so they don’t get pushed out.
* **Worker-owned cooperatives** , where all members get an equal share of profits and an equal voice in how things run.
* **Returning citizens** who are pursuing dreams of entrepreneurship.

As Detroit Justice Center explains on their website: _“We help establish new ways of organizing society... Resistance, in its most potent form, is not only clear about what it is against, but also specific in what it is aiming for. ...We’re actively building up new structures defined by democracy and dignity.”_ 3
The group has established six community land trusts for community-owned affordable housing in majority-Black Detroit, and helped establish 12 worker-owned cooperatives that are BIPOC* woman-led—including a childcare collective, green grocer, and mobile wellness hub. clean_body: Today is dedicated to supporting Black-led non-profit organizations. | | | Friend, Yesterday we recognized August 28, a national day to give to Black-led non-profit organizations. The day also marks important moments in Black Americans’ long fight for freedom and equity. For example, on August 28 1963, over 250,000 people joined the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, where Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. gave his “I Have a Dream” speech. I joined the Black-led group Detroit Justice Center at last year’s Detroit MLK Day Rally and March, where we spoke about his anti-war and pro-worker legacy. I’m proud to work alongside this non-profit law firm in the push for racial justice, economic equity, and a transformed criminal legal system. Detroit Justice Center’s movement lawyers represent protesters, such as anti-war students for Palestine and people impacted by police brutality—successfully getting charges dismissed. The group has also won transformative victories to protect our right to protest, clear criminal records, and end profit-seeking predatory policing. Together, we’ve rallied and educated local residents on alternatives to incarceration. As a thought partner, Detroit Justice Center uplifts the needs of currently and formerly incarcerated people, helping shape my policies for housing justice and for shifting public funds to community needs rather than state violence. | Photo from a training led by Detroit Justice Center’s Restorative Justice Network A national leader in the fight to transform the criminal legal system, Detroit Justice Center fights against the cash bail system and the debt-to-jail pipeline that keeps people locked in cycles of poverty. While pushing to end racist policing, the group also provides urgent legal services to keep clients out of jail and remove barriers to housing and employment. Detroit Justice Center helps pay off people’s court debt, expunge records, reunite families involved in the criminal legal system, and keep people in their homes by assisting in eviction cases and helping people keep their water on. Detroit Justice Center also empowers people to navigate and transform unjust systems and to create solidarity economies with democratically governed cooperatives. They provide legal support to returning citizens seeking to start businesses, as well as to community land trusts seeking to build affordable housing, and worker cooperatives led by Black women and women of color. Detroit Justice Center is building infrastructure for truly democratic systems and for restorative justice (an alternative way of addressing harm). They’re also pushing to divest from policing and incarceration and instead invest in our communities’ health and well-being. I’m proud to fight for this in Congress: I won’t stop demanding to move money from state violence to community needs such as housing and healthcare. Detroit Justice Center’s staff and board members include formerly incarcerated people who understand the struggle. A post on their website references the tradition of Black August, which honors political prisoners and those who gave their lives to the movement for Black liberation: “Black August draws our attention to both a long legacy of Black folks’ resistance to oppression and the role of the prison in suppressing that resistance. Our work at the Detroit Justice Center proudly draws from that long legacy of rebellion and boldly calls for an end to all forms of policing and incarceration.” 1 Thank you for helping Detroit Justice Center build “a world where every human life is valued with equal care and consideration and disposing of people is no longer considered justice.” We’ll keep working toward that world together. In solidarity, Rashida 1 \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Thu, Aug 28, 2025 Subject: I’m uplifting Detroit Justice Center on National Black Giving Day: To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, Today isNational Black Giving Day to support Black-led organizations , which are often underfunded and get only 1-2% of philanthropic funding.1 We must correct this disparity, as part of the urgent work to close the still-growing racial wealth gap between white and Black communities. , a Black-led non-profit law firm that’s a national leader in transforming our unjust criminal legal system. They’ve won meaningful policy changes, including securing our right to protest. Detroit Justice Center uplifts the unique needs of formerly and currently incarcerated people, and has helped shape policies I have introduced in Congress to end mass incarceration and bring about housing justice. They’ve represented 10,000 clients, including people caught up in the legal system due to poverty, people struggling to keep their water on and stay in their homes, and anti-war student protesters who’ve been targeted because of their advocacy for Palestinian liberation. Their work is urgently needed as those in power increase political repression and aggressive law enforcement. Last month, Detroit Justice Center got a notification that an environmental justice grant they applied for was unlawfully terminated by the current administration. As the administration targets funding for diversity, equity, and inclusion, Detroit Justice Center is also facing a downturn in philanthropic support for racial justice work. We need to counter these attacks by the Trump administration with thousands of grassroots donations. Photo of me with Detroit Justice Center Community Legal Advocate Sonja Bonnet, after she spoke at a rally about the struggle Black Detroiters face with illegal tax foreclosures. Together, we’ve rallied and educated local residents on alternatives to incarceration—and each year Detroit Justice Center educates the next generation of freedom fighters at our Youth Civic Engagement Fellowship. Detroit Justice Center has won fights to secure our right to protest and to expand criminal record expungement opportunities. They’re providing urgent legal services to keep clients out of jail—through helping pay off people’s court debt, reinstating licenses, and removing obstacles such as warrants for unpaid fees. They’re also reuniting families involved in the criminal legal system, andkeeping people in their homes by assisting in eviction cases and helping people keep their water on. Detroit Justice Center’s initiatives include shifting funds out of policing and increasing investment in non-carceral solutions , training residents on how to mediate harm without relying on police (also known as restorative justice), and helping people imagine a world without prisons or police. They envision a “future where every life is valued equally,” including “affordable and safe housing for all.”2 As part of that vision, Detroit Justice Center pushes for economic self-determination, providing legal support to: Community land trusts , which allow residents to own land and decide what development looks like in their neighborhoods so they don’t get pushed out. Worker-owned cooperatives , where all members get an equal share of profits and an equal voice in how things run. Returning citizens who are pursuing dreams of entrepreneurship. As Detroit Justice Center explains on their website: “We help establish new ways of organizing society... Resistance, in its most potent form, is not only clear about what it is against, but also specific in what it is aiming for. ...We’re actively building up new structures defined by democracy and dignity.” 3 The group has established six community land trusts for community-owned affordable housing in majority-Black Detroit, and helped establish 12 worker-owned cooperatives that are BIPOC woman-led—including a childcare collective, green grocer, and mobile wellness hub. They’re sharing these models with groups building solidarity economies around the country. Thank you, Rashida P.S. Peter, The redistricting fight playing out right now in several states will have national implications for fair maps and representation. Here’s a rundown of how we got here and what’s at stake: _**FIRST**_ : The Trump White House demanded Texas conduct a mid-decade redraw to manipulate its congressional map — a brazen power grab to help Republicans hold on to power. _**THEN**_ : Texas Republicans did exactly that, passing a racially gerrymandered map that dilutes minority voting power and could flip five seats in the midterms. _**NOW**_ : The White House is ramping up pressure for more states to pass similar extreme gerrymanders, openly pressuring hesitant legislators in Indiana and Missouri to get in line and follow Texas’s lead. That’s on top of a redistricting process already underway in Ohio, which could wipe out three more Democratic seats. **Peter, we're looking at an all-out brawl. Republicans have launched an unprecedented attack on our democracy, and it’s going to require an extraordinary effort to fight back and win.** California is taking the fight directly to voters by asking them to approve a new, temporary map that will undo some of the damage done by Texas and other states. We’ll be mobilizing voters on the ground to make their voices heard. At the same time, the fair maps movement is challenging Texas’s racial gerrymander in court. Together, we’re pushing back on multiple fronts against this attempt to thwart the will of voters. But this is a tough fight that will require significant resources. #### **Phil Izon's efforts against RCV demonstrate significant accomplishments:**
• **Authored and Sponsored Repeal Legislation:** He personally **wrote the bill to repeal RCV** in his living room, based on returning election laws to their pre-2022 state. He secured **180 sponsors for his initial legislation** , including former Governor Sarah Palin, who was the first to sign, along with former lieutenant governors and former state senators.• **Led a Historic Grassroots Signature Drive:** Izon initiated and led a **"volunteer" signature-gathering campaign** with over 700 volunteers. He personally collected over 2,000 signatures. The campaign submitted approximately **42,000 signatures** to the Alaska Division of Elections, far exceeding the 26,705 required.• **Achieved Ballot Qualification:** His efforts resulted in the certification of **37,043 signatures** , meeting the necessary district-wide thresholds to place the repeal measure on the 2024 ballot.• **Secured Legal Victories Against Challenges:** The repeal measure **"successfully defended the ballot measure with unanimous victories in both the Alaska Superior Court and the Alaska Supreme Court"** against attempts to disqualify it. This involved facing legal challenges regarding signature collection integrity. He specifically states he **"dealt with 2 hours of testimony and 6 hours of deposition to win those cases"****If I had made mistakes on the petition process which I was 100% Responsible for the submission and management of. Then we would not have won the Superior Court and Supreme Court Cases, if my team did not create technology solutions to screen for fraudulent books, we would not have won these cases. It was great management and a great team that won these court cases, ignoring these very important contributions is a slap in the face to me and to my team.** • **Established a National Educational Platform:** He founded the **Ranked Choice Education Association, RCValert.org, RemoveRCV.com, and NoRCV.com** , a group of national organizations providing educational resources to multiple states, including a 30-part animated video series RCV Election Simulators, Interactive Guidebook, Chatbots, and more, to inform the public about RCV's perceived flaws.• **Published Extensive Research:** Izon authored books such as "Rank Choice Voting Illusions of Choice" and "(manufactured) Majority," which delve into the history, funding, and real-world impacts of RCV, particularly in Alaska.• **Advocated and Influenced Across the Nation:** He has become a prominent **national expert against RCV** , delivering presentations and debates to presidential candidates, U.S. Congressional members, state legislators in over 35 states, and multiple secretaries of state. Even debated 3 Oregon Legislative members, 3 Alaska Legislative members, and U.S. Presidential Candidate Chase Oliver on RCV.• **Contributed to RCV Rejections in Other States:** His advocacy is credited with **helping prevent the adoption of RCV in six other states** and inspiring national debates about the system.• **Persisted Despite Overwhelming Odds:** His campaign was **outspent by a margin of 100-to-1** , with opponents contributing approximately $15 million compared to his group's fraction of a million, yet he only lost by a "razor-thin margin" of 0.1% (743 votes).

The President made his decision. I backed him. But we’re still waiting on you. | Peter,

President Trump made his decision. I've made mine. And now... we're waiting on you.

This isn't a routine announcement. It's a strategic move that could determine the balance of power in the Senate - and the future of the America First movement.

####
# Indiana Civil and Human Rights Experts Unite!
Register for the Free Online Panel Discussion
---
| Hey everyone! A lot is going on in our country! Those of you who know me know how passionate I am about civil and human rights.

I wanted to share an exciting opportunity coming up for you to tune in to a live, free online panel discussion on the state of civil and human rights in Indiana and the region, hosted by the Indiana Consortium of State & Local Human Rights Agencies.

The Indiana Consortium of State & Local Human Rights Agencies was established in 1972 and combines all civil and human rights agencies across Indiana to provide free training and education to its members and the general public in Indiana.

Get ready for an engaging online live free panel discussion featuring the brightest minds in civil and human rights in the State of Indiana!

This webinar brings together top experts for a lively discussion on the impact of the most recent executive orders, empowerment through civil and human rights organizations, and voting rights in Indiana and the region.

**SHARE! **

**Date: Wednesday, September 24, 2025 **

**Time: 11:00 a.m. EST - 2:00 p.m. EST**

Peter, Donald Trump does not give a rip about anyone who isn’t a billionaire. Not only did his Big, Ugly Bill jeopardize health care for millions of Americans and rip food assistance away from those who need it most, his tariffs are making life more expensive for families all across the country. On the campaign trail he promised to _lower_ prices for Americans and make things _more_ affordable — **but if Donald Trump’s lips are moving, he’s lying.** Americans will now be forced to pay close to **_18%_** more for imported goods thanks to Trump’s tariffs. | | _**Honoring Hoosier Workers, Building Indiana’s Future**_
---
Friends, This Labor Day, we will pause to honor the determination and spirit of the Hoosier workforce—the men and women whose hard work has built Indiana into the economic engine of the Midwest. From farms and factories to small businesses and startups, our state’s strength has always come from the values of faith, family, and freedom lived out every day in the workplace. Under President Trump’s America First agenda and Governor Braun’s Freedom and Opportunity Agenda, Hoosiers are seeing the benefits of leadership that puts workers first. Lower taxes, fewer regulations, and a renewed commitment to American manufacturing have helped create jobs, spur investment, and keep Indiana on a path of growth and opportunity. Labor Day is both a celebration of the dignity of work and a reminder of the responsibility our leaders have to safeguard opportunity for the next generation. That commitment was reflected this week as Governor Braun marked important milestones for Indiana’s future, investing in both our economy and the next generation of Hoosier leaders. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with.
---
| |
---
| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman

| | _**Governor Braun Announces Sale of Former GM Stamping Plant Property to Elanco**_
---
---
Governor Braun announced the sale of the former GM Stamping Plant property in Indianapolis to Elanco Animal Health for $27 million, paving the way for a world-class innovation district anchored by Elanco’s new global headquarters. With Purdue University and the State of Indiana as key partners, the project will bring research, labs, housing, retail, and green space together in a vibrant hub designed to create jobs, attract talent, and drive long-term economic growth for Indianapolis. a "This agreement is a responsible step forward. It places this property in the hands of a company with a clear vision of a world-class innovation district, while ensuring the State of Indiana remains a full partner in what comes next. ## AI Restores Woman's Voice
A London woman who lost her voice to motor neuron disease 25 years ago [can speak again](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3O5CAQRE-DM0a4_UtAsImz2XRDi51uDCtMj4Cx5duvPFf4slKV9FR6f57r04YY0vbb7mTc5tbqeE10lki1Ul5bdZHNHNHZvFPeOCKlTDWvoGCQapagV7QhXmvfoHFEQF1Dpp2GsdeT7trGm2lAQot6avVfO48Tzq3uuw6ssi8NODfB3DQ1gwalBhges-67flSDmgixVVr0ijBUzo9_HFL15OLFB-XHi_cmGl_ru4jul4BFwJKuN5d6TwKWGyxgUfOdWwGLJxurF7CcvNskT8-yfJyjXKTLvMudK2eZ6JM5SQyFbCHpQsIiPWV5cHiRtK5S_rYhbZIjysMXeQQkFrA02eD7DDGGMk6iV9tuQ_xerT92fBj4HwAA__-M95Hv)--thanks to artificial intelligence and a grainy home video. Sarah Ezekiel, diagnosed in 2000, had relied on a robotic speech device until tech firm Smartbox rebuilt her natural voice from an eight-second VHS clip from the 1990s. The scratchy audio, recorded as she changed her baby daughter's diaper, [was processed through AI tools](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNtDzwzZ48NAlW7p2tEz8DG4NLzJOIv6-Sn-h-9U9Oufr6q4-5bQvn34jG5foamS30-vIVCsVJ-AkXziH6MtGZeEcaC9Ui0NA1cHUoXHBp3w62QYbiZCGlqwYlZZmNINoVzsbQBwhauP1jF7dRNAStNLeT3Mk2Sb7foMJDQIoVP1k5CA1KBgpBAGmkUAhVS79N6e9rhTzyU8q_Y23Ntu11vvRDB8NXhq8PH76t0F_-pX5vWjwsnHl0u30KLxTF9JB_qCu8DxT6J6cbtQJgaD0AGO_1i23xYb7K-WcDj02EpbNp_yHq__u9LT4GwAA__9u5X0J) from ElevenLabs to recreate her Cockney accent. For her now-grown kids, it's the first time they've heard their mom's real voice. [Sarah calls it life-changing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFqKyEUxvGncXYZjsfRGRcuLtyGUkihi9KlmHicsTgajMkwb1_SV-j2--C3-H-d7MnFFPP87lYyYQ62hWIzbbdErVG1HHZytSQfXF2pziV5ypVatQgoDzAdUFvvYtrt0HkTiJBER4aPUg161IJ3i9FBkiCYuNDIL94pTwEEDwphPGtQXTRPDSbUCCBR9pMexKBAwkjec9BsAPKxldp_l5jbQiHt5UG1v5S1S2Zp7Xpj4h_DI8Pjtm39Xu7tfqbn_1xcuyxMHB9M_H97qdnq_PlaP7pq_HWLKcWbGtkA8-pi-iXbn1s8DP4EAAD__wtVcuY)--and says it finally sounds like "the real me" is speaking.
## 10-Year-Old Farmer Earns Full Ride
Kendall Rae Johnson, a 10-year-old from Atlanta and the youngest U.S. Department of Agriculture-certified farmer in the U.S., [has received a full-ride scholarship](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAQQL_G7ohgDLYpKK5Jl2uvRFwYY7JjsAaUKH-_yv7C1k96T3r_bv4WMuWS_oYD3ZY237fqC74aYe_IXsk3Bq4Ut8AHcqoUsTB29iDBCLkKsD6GTG-vx-g2RMBpRKcWM2u72EmNu5OwqtnaFZQ1OGkEpSap0Uz_wc7R6DG7j02uYEFKA-ayWj3pWRq5YIxK2kFLjLlXvjxqLn3Hjd71iXy512Mkt_d-tmH6M8B1gOuJ9ST8oAGuCSunHETKTOILSwxEggOKR91Lq0Vg4NLEvRJhQtHue6XAbc-nUGqxZl7syC6er0yU27wMWqYjZPop918vezr4DgAA___qOoBb) to South Carolina State University. The [$83,800 award](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SpSAURleDGRZcf5CAYBKzN-mEFiMXZQbhFVyf5e67XnfvoDfwfeecP4_lYUMMafttDzR-8wv5vCS8akQiLIsUN9qSo_O2HFi2HB2mglQWEDBwMXHQi7Mh3kvfOOMRAbsGjVTD2GulO9nsRk09rCgnq7XTCifpvP-rtJqsBStxbIJ5r4kJNAgxwNBOuu_6UQxCoXNSaNYLdIFyaf_lkGhHH-_8wtKu-Wii2YmelXW_GMwM5uu62k-kw4bYrrk9_zOY31IMZlsorBG5HEQnRugYzHc-04aV-Jcjr-ueoy11D09e80k7X98JQrL8TOGFpQa6252O2BTjnleIMdRRsV5s349HQz-O-TLwEQAA__9Ic4vq) was presented during her visit to the campus, where leaders praised Kendall's rare passion for agriculture, noting her deep knowledge of microorganisms, crop counts, and livestock. _" It's not every day you meet a 10-year-old who talks about microorganisms, crop counts, and longhorn cattle,"_ said SC State President Alexander Conyers about Kendall. Kendall started growing collard greens at age three and now farms an acre of family land, providing fresh produce to her community.
## Puppy Love With a Purpose
In rural Australia, a daily minibus full of dogs is part of a program giving young people with disabilities real jobs and real skills. [See photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFyrSAYxfHVYIeDn4BaULzG7r42pYNyVBIUB7nXcfeZmyIbyAb-8zvn4zE8rA9-X_7bDWZe5iHPcdhxnQE5Iw2VuGFTDG62aUNaYnDYE3IaSJDiouXUDc76cA-ycGYGCHUBUzVKy67p6qpYzVTXWmg4Pap2UiNUJbTWEqQVKinawpt3TbTUkRCKVNl2spZaKNHAuUp0TAo4n2MqP6Pf84o53PGFVE5xK4JZcz5OVv9j1DPqr-sq7TiVO3Jpn4z69x5G_a9YMupdXLizN59sAh-fJz8n7H7iyW98RThO7vxpxwDHD8QjgG_2C3xOHrt71yqhdK1akkUy7rh8CP7UDZNi2awPP7D850dfhr4DAAD__9lmiKY). At IronBark DogPark in Boonah, trainer Jo Mcvilly pairs trainees with dogs for daily care, grooming, and socialization at a custom-built adventure park. The program has pulled in over [3 million social media views](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uwyAUxfGnwVusy5dtBoZKVbZ07YiIuRBqDNENipW3r9JX6HqO9Bv-3xd38bnkmr78jjam6HpsruLxKNg7kuPwQk-thOhpR0qtBKyEnZwAoU-wnIRxwefycmoINiIKlANaPutJmdlIPtwsmmkRy2yCQVgBVq7WoDFGnHjUV66GbN8aLMIIAC30uBgl1QQaZgyBg2EKMOTeaPxpufYbxvJqT6RxbftQ7K33-4PJDybOTJyP4xh73nrb3vd7U5Cp1aunLbR097QxeS6-JiY_sQ5kw_3IpeTHNDMFafe5_MH930WeVvwGAAD__z5cdbk), with viewers drawn to its mix of routine, joy, and purpose. Participants say working with animals helps them feel calmer, more confident, and part of something meaningful.

# Tulare County Deputy Sheriff’s Association Endorses Magsig for Senate
---
|
---
| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** August 29th, 2025Contact: nathan@nathanmagsig.com
---
| | | | | | **Magsig Announces Additional Law Enforcement Support**
**(Clovis, CA)** \- Today, Nathan Magsig announced that he received the endorsement of the Tulare County Deputy Sheriff’s Association for his State Senate campaign.
Magsig released the following statement: _“It is an honor to have the support of the Tulare County Deputy Sheriff’s Association. The TCDSA knows I’m committed to prioritizing public safety and our local communities. I look forward to continue working closely with law enforcement and every county in Senate District 12 to make our Valley safer.”_
This announcement shows that Nathan Magsig is law enforcement's clear choice for State Senate District 12. The TCDSA joins an extensive list of law enforcement support for Magsig’s State Senate campaign, including: Fresno County Deputy Sheriff’s Association, Clovis Police Officers Association, Fresno Police Officers Association & Foundation, Fresno DA Investigators Association, Fresno County Prosecutors' Association, Fresno Mayor & Fmr Chief of Police Jerry Dyer, Fresno County DA Lisa Smittcamp, Fresno County Sheriff John Zanoni, & Fmr. Fresno Sheriff Margaret Mims.

---
| | ###
Nathan Magsig is a current Fresno County Supervisor, former Mayor of Clovis, and is running for the 12th Senate District. His family, wife Julie and their three children, reside in Clovis, CA.

Dear Peter, There’s nothing like worship in the mountains! 🌄 This **Sunday at 7:00 PM** , join us for a powerful night of revival at:📍 **Caras Park (123 Carousel Dr, Missoula, MT 59802)** God keeps calling us back to Montana—and we’re responding with faith and fire. For the three days it takes to drive from the Pacific Northwest to Central Texas, we will be stopping along the way to collect supplies to bring with us and distribute to families affected by the flooding.
See below for what to bring and where to drop it off. Let’s be the hands and feet of Jesus to hurting people! _**What to Bring:**_
* Walmart gift cards
* Home Depot gift cards
* Lowe’s gift gift cards
Construction tools & supplies
Monetary donations
